In the balanced branch the pre-absorption diagonal is still paid explicitly. After absorption the diagonal is density times a real square, so the signed off-diagonal is no larger than the full next-stage correlation. No sign of the off-diagonal is assumed, no distinct-prime conditioning is used, and no error is lost during restoration.
